Class SshClientProperties

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientProperties
public class SshClientProperties extends Object
The SshClientProperties store is the per-user SSH client file. The file is ssh-client.yaml inside the .casserole folder under the user home directory. The first load may import .ssh-client.properties from the user home directory once. That import runs only when the YAML file is not already there. The theme reads its colors from this store. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshClientProperties

  • Constructor Details

    • SshClientProperties

      public SshClientProperties()
      The constructor creates an empty store pointed at the per-user YAML file. No accounts are stored yet.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static SshClientProperties load()
      The method loads the store from disk and fills any missing known keys. A missing file is not an error. The returned store is never null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the loaded store.

    • readFromDisk

      public void readFromDisk()
      The method reads the YAML file when that file exists. A missing YAML file is not an error. A missing YAML file may still import the legacy properties file. The legacy file is .ssh-client.properties in the user home directory. A legacy username that is not empty is stored as an account. That account keeps the legacy password and the legacy remember flag. A read error prints Unable to read plus the path and the exception message.

    • save

      public void save()
      The method writes the current store to the YAML file as UTF-8. A missing parent folder is created. Property keys are written in sorted order. Each account is written as a username and a password. A null account password is written as an empty string. The file begins with the line # Casserole standalone SSH client. A write error prints Unable to write plus the path and the exception message.

    • applyDefaultsForMissingKeys

      public void applyDefaultsForMissingKeys()
      The method fills missing keys with the version 1 defaults. A key that is already present is left as stored. The frame size defaults are 1024 by 968. The product tab defaults to ssh. The host defaults to localhost. The port defaults to 22. The username defaults to the user.name property, or empty when that property is missing. Remember-password defaults to false. The mode defaults to the VT100 property value. The idle timeout defaults to 0, which does not disconnect for idle time. The font size defaults to 20. Each color key defaults to its DEFAULT_ hex constant.

    • saveIfFileMissing

      public void saveIfFileMissing()
      The method writes the defaults the first time the YAML file is created. An existing file is not rewritten. The colors are then present for a person to edit.

    • upsertAccount

      public void upsertAccount(String username, String password, boolean remember)
      The method adds or updates one remembered account. A null or blank username returns without a change. The stored name is trimmed. The password is stored only when remember is true and the password is not null. Otherwise the stored password is empty. An existing name has its password replaced. A new name is appended.
      Parameters:
      username - The username is the account name.
      password - The password is the secret to store when remember is true.
      remember - The flag is true when the password should be kept.

    • readYaml

      private void readYaml(File yamlFile)
      The method reads one YAML file into the property table. A root that is not a map returns without a change. The accounts entry is passed to loadAccounts(Object). Every other non-null value is stored as text. A read error prints Unable to read plus the path and the exception message.
      Parameters:
      yamlFile - The file is the YAML store to read.

    • loadAccounts

      private void loadAccounts(Object raw)
      The method replaces the account list from the YAML accounts value. A value that is not a list clears the list and returns. A row that is not a map is skipped. A blank username is skipped. A null password is stored as empty.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the YAML accounts node.

    • parseHexColor

      public static Color parseHexColor(String raw)
      The method parses #rrggbb or rrggbb. A null or blank string returns null. A missing # is added before decoding. A nine-character value is read as #aarrggbb. Any other length is passed to Color.decode. A number that cannot be parsed returns null.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text is the hex string.
      Returns:
      The return value is the color, or null when the text cannot be parsed.

      Returns:
